newsitem.title: UK: Fairey says current trading satisfactory.
newsitem.headline: Fairey says current trading satisfactory.

text.p: Electronics and engineering manufacturer Fairey Group Plc said the group's overall trading performance in the current year has been satisfactory.
"The majority of our U.S. electronics businesses are booking orders at rates usefully higher than in the same period of 1996," chairman Sir Robin Biggam told the annual meeting.
"The recovery in the semiconductor market will progressively help the performance of our companies trading in that sector," he added
He said the two Burnfield Plc businesses, Malvern and Beta, acquired at the end of January are trading in line with plan.
"The Group is maintaining its investments in developing its products and markets. The Board expects that Fairey will make further positive progress during the current year," Biggam said.
